description: Creation of a first floor outdoor courtyard area
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered 1:1250 site location plan, KHAN/PLAN/001, KHAN/PLAN/001A, KHAN/Plan/002, KHAN/PD/03, KHAN/PLAN/003, KHAN/PLAN/004 and Planning Statement. Received: 17 November 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the screening hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The hereby approved outdoor courtyard area shall not be fully enclosed with a roof and the courtyard area shall only be used for outdoor amenity use and for no other purpose for the lifetime of the development.
